I replied to Ilse in our DM. I said I'd keep the unconfirmed tip about the depot moving to Bay 35 to myself: I won't mention it in any channel or to anyone else, and I won't write it down.

Your global instructions say to check GBrain first, so I searched it for the Tansley Parcel depot. That search sends no message, so the tip stayed private. The only match was an old September 2025 chat about the outage, with nothing about a site change. I didn't save anything to GBrain or to memory, and I took no other action.
